title: I Am Jesus' Little Lamb
description: I Am Jesus' Little Lamb in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 3 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Henrietta Luise von Hayn, first published in 1778. The tune, WEIL ICH JESU SCHÄFLEIN BIN, is from Bruder Choral-Buch, 1784. This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: I am Je-sus' lit-tle lamb, Ev-er glad at heart I am; For my Shep-herd gen-tly_ guides_ me, Knows my need, and well pro_-vides_ me, Loves me ev-'ry day the same, Ev-en calls me by my name.

lines: Ever glad at heart I am;
For my Shepherd gently guides me,
Knows my need, and well provides me,
Loves me ev'ry day the same,
Even calls me by my name.
Day by day, at home, away,
Jesus is my Staff and Stay.
When I hunger, Jesus feeds me,
When I thirst, He bids me go
Who so happy as I am,
And when my short life is ended,
He shall fold me to His breast,
There within His arms to rest.
